svg.aria-label: Baggage Volume Forecasting. Checked bags per flight, forecast for ground-crew staffing. American Airlines, baggage operations. Public repository on GitHub. Business problem: Ground-crew staffing depends on expected bags per flight. Underestimates delay baggage and hurt customer satisfaction. Overestimates create excess labor costs. Solution: A neural network that forecasts checked-bag volume per flight from flight and schedule attributes to support staffing decisions. My contributions: Feed-forward architecture with categorical embeddings, 288-configuration hyperparameter search, and evaluation on 24,711 held-out flights. Built with PyTorch, pandas, Parquet, SQL.

g.text: Checked bags per flight, forecast for ground-crew staffing.

svg.aria-label: Baggage forecasting. A plane flies a track from DFW across a forecast map of bags per flight into a radar scope centered on Atlanta, where other arrivals light up with forecast bag counts. Illustrative.
